overlapTest.preStated: scratchpad gaps/PRESTATED.md 2026-09-22T10:27Z: overlap = hours both streams cover / hours either covers (host-clock windows of the two scored files); (a) Spearman(overlap, |delta|); (b) cross-node Spearman with both files cut to the intersection and re-scored; HOLDS (b) >= 0.4 or (a) <= -0.4; FAILS (b) <= 0.2 and |(a)| < 0.2; INDETERMINATE otherwise; nights with < 2 h overlap excluded and counted
overlapTest.verdict: INDETERMINATE by the bands (b = 0.255 over 17 nights, between 0.2 and 0.4; a = -0.08) — but the direction is the candidate's: restricting both nodes to the hours they BOTH covered lifts the cross-node rho from 0.05 to 0.26, and 6 of 23 box nights had the two scored streams overlapping for LESS THAN 2 h (the largest ECG fragment and the largest PPG fragment sit in different parts of the night), which is the mechanism in its clearest form: two indices over disjoint hours. Partial support, not a ruling. Combined with the 55 Hz grid (about a fifth), where the drop cut and how it cut are the two named terms; what remains is unexplained

mergedSessionsView.method: per night, the UNION of every Polar_H10 _ECG.txt fragment's host window and of every Polar_VeritySense _PPG.txt fragment's (the fold merges all concurrent sessions — trio-batch); overlap = hours both / hours either over those unions; windows only, no re-score
mergedSessionsView.finding: the sweep scored the LARGEST fragment per stream; on the fold's view four of the six < 2 h nights (2026-08-28, 08-30, 09-06, 09-10) overlap 3.0-11.3 h — those four were the SWEEP'S SELECTION, not the drop. Two nights (2026-08-29: 0.7 h, 2026-09-19: 1.1 h) stay under 2 h on the merged view: the mechanism (two indices over disjoint hours) is real there. The restricted-window rho of 0.255 was computed over the selected fragments and is a statement about the sweep's scoring; the fold's number needs the merged-session re-score (next step, not run: PpgDex refuses CVHR on a clock seam, so merged multi-fragment nights will partly refuse — that count is itself the finding to record)
